newsitem.title: USA: Manor Care sues GranCare over pact.
newsitem.headline: Manor Care sues GranCare over pact.

text.p: Manor Care Inc said Tuesday it filed a joint lawsuit with Vitalink Pharmacy Services Inc against GranCare Inc to enforce a noncompetition agreement between the companies.
Manor Care, which owns 51 percent of Vitalink, said the pact it and Vitalink have with GranCare was entered into in February 1997.

It said its complaint states that GranCare, a provider of specialty medical services and long-term care, is prohibited from joining with or participating in a company in the institutional pharmacy business for three years.
Living Centers of America Inc, which has a subsidiary that is an institutional pharmacy company, is proposing to acquire GranCare.
